title.en: A trip you will never forget

es: Contar un viaje memorable, reaccionar con énfasis al relato de otra persona y escribir una reseña breve combinando inversión y so… that.

teaching.en: Never had we taken such an unforgettable journey.
teaching.es: Jamás habíamos hecho un viaje tan inolvidable.
teaching.explanationEs: Never had we + participio: el auxiliar va antes del sujeto.
teaching.audioText: Never had we taken such an unforgettable journey.

teaching.en: Hardly had the sunrise begun when our guide pointed at the summit.
teaching.es: Apenas había empezado el amanecer cuando nuestro guía señaló la cima.
teaching.explanationEs: Hardly had + sujeto + participio, y when para lo que ocurre a continuación.
segments: Hardly had the sunrise begun when
our guide pointed at the summit.
teaching.audioText: Hardly had the sunrise begun when our guide pointed at the summit.

teaching.en: So beautiful was the view from the summit that nobody spoke.
teaching.es: Tan hermosa era la vista desde la cima que nadie habló.
teaching.explanationEs: So + adjetivo + was + sujeto + that + consecuencia.
segments: So beautiful was the view from
teaching.audioText: So beautiful was the view from the summit that nobody spoke.

teaching.en: Not only did we reach the top, but we also saw the sunrise.
teaching.es: No solo llegamos a la cima, sino que también vimos el amanecer.
teaching.explanationEs: Not only did + sujeto + verbo base; después, but … also.
segments: Not only did we reach the top,
but we also saw the sunrise.
teaching.audioText: Not only did we reach the top, but we also saw the sunrise.

teaching.en: Wow, never had I heard such an amazing story!
teaching.es: ¡Vaya, jamás había oído una historia tan asombrosa!
teaching.explanationEs: Una reacción breve con never had I sirve para responder con énfasis al relato de otro.
teaching.audioText: Wow, never had I heard such an amazing story!

prompt.es: Elige la reacción enfática correcta al relato de Sara sobre su maratón.

choices.text: Never have I met anyone who ran a marathon!
Never I have met anyone who ran a marathon!
Never met I anyone who ran a marathon!

feedback.es: La reacción enfática coloca have antes de I tras never; las otras dos cambian el orden de forma incorrecta.

hint.es: Con never al inicio, el auxiliar va antes del sujeto.

prompt.es: Completa: «Apenas habíamos salido del hotel cuando empezó a llover.»

feedback.es: Hardly had… se cierra con when para unir la segunda acción.

hint.es: Es el conector propio de hardly.

origin.text: Hardly had we left the hotel ___ it started to rain.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Tan largo fue el viaje que todos durmieron.»

answer.text: So long was the journey that everybody slept

feedback.es: So long abre la frase, was precede a the journey y that introduce lo que pasó.

hint.es: Empieza con so + adjetivo y sigue el verbo be.

prompt.es: Escucha: ¿qué más les pasó en la cima, además de llegar?

choices.text: They met a person known for climbing mountains.
They took photos of a famous building.

feedback.es: Not only… but also… suma un segundo hecho: encontraron a un famoso escalador en la cima.

origin.audio: Not only did we see the summit, but we also met a famous climber at the top.

prompt.es: Completa tres frases enfáticas sobre la noche en la montaña.

feedback.es: Seldom pide do en presente simple, no sooner se une con than y so quietly exige did antes del sujeto.

sentences: Seldom ___ you see a sunrise as beautiful as this.
No sooner had we started the climb ___ it began to snow.
So quietly ___ the guide walk that we heard nothing.

prompt.es: Reacciona con énfasis al relato de Mia usando never y un participio.

answer.text: Never had I heard such an amazing story!
accepted: Never had I heard such an amazing story!
Never have I heard such an amazing story!
Never before had I heard such an amazing story!
Never had I heard such an amazing story.
Never have I heard such an amazing story.

feedback.es: La reacción enfática usa never + had o have antes de I y un participio: heard.

origin.text: Mia: «Ayer vi ballenas desde el barco.» Reacciona diciendo que nunca habías oído una historia tan asombrosa.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué esperaban los viajeros antes del viaje.

choices.text: They knew the week would be terrible.
They had planned the best week of their lives.
They did not expect the trip to be so good.

feedback.es: Little did we know… indica que no imaginaban lo buena que sería la semana.

origin.audio: Little did we know that the trip would be the best week of our lives.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo se unen con énfasis las dos frases del texto?

choices.text: No sooner had we reached the hotel than the storm began.
No sooner had we reached the hotel when the storm began.
No sooner we had reached the hotel than the storm began.

feedback.es: No sooner had precede al sujeto y se une con than; when pertenece a hardly.

origin.text: We reached the hotel. The storm began at once.

prompt.es: Completa: «Tan bello era el lago que todos sacaron fotos.»

feedback.es: Con so + adjetivo al inicio, el verbo be pasa antes del sujeto: was the lake.

origin.text: So beautiful ___ the lake that everybody took photos.

prompt.es: Escribe la reseña de tu viaje con tres estructuras enfáticas y una reacción.

answer.text: Last weekend we took the train to the coast. Hardly had we left the station when it began to rain, but the hotel was lovely. So kind was the owner that he gave us breakfast for free. Not only was the food delicious, but the view of the sea was also stunning. Never had I spent such a relaxing weekend. My friend said, Seldom do you find a place like this!
accepted: Last weekend we took the train to the coast. Hardly had we left the station when it began to rain, but the hotel was lovely. So kind was the owner that he gave us breakfast for free. Not only was the food delicious, but the view of the sea was also stunning. Never had I spent such a relaxing weekend. My friend said, Seldom do you find a place like this!

Last weekend we went to the coast by train. No sooner had we left the station than it began to rain, but the hotel was lovely. So kind was the owner that he gave us breakfast for free. Not only was the food delicious, but the view of the sea was also beautiful. Never have I spent such a relaxing weekend. My friend said, Rarely do you find a place like this!

feedback.es: La reseña combina una inversión tras adverbio negativo, hardly o no sooner, so… that, not only… but also y una reacción enfática de la amiga.

origin.text: Datos: viaje en tren a la costa el fin de semana pasado; apenas salieron de la estación empezó a llover; el dueño del hotel era tan amable que les regaló el desayuno; la comida no solo era deliciosa, también la vista al mar era preciosa; jamás habías pasado un fin de semana tan relajante; una amiga reaccionó diciendo que rara vez se encuentra un lugar así. Escribe unas 80 palabras.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Rara vez oímos una historia tan buena.»

answer.text: Rarely do we hear such a good story

feedback.es: Rarely abre la frase, do precede a we y hear vuelve a la forma base.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase sobre el viaje contiene un error?

choices.text: Not only did Leo lose his bag, but he also missed his flight.
Hardly had the plane landed than it began to snow.
So tired was Mia that she slept on the train.

feedback.es: Hardly se une con when, no con than; las otras dos frases tienen el orden y el conector correctos.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué nadie oyó el aviso.

choices.text: There was too much noise in the airport.

feedback.es: Such was the noise that… presenta el ruido como causa de que nadie oyera el aviso.

origin.audio: Such was the noise at the airport that nobody heard the announcement.
